name: Mövenpick Hotel Jakarta City Centre
short_description: A 5-star Mövenpick with 256 rooms and suites 400m from Istiqlal Mosque and Jakarta Cathedral, 800m from Monas, holding a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (1,792 reviews).
ai_summary: Mövenpick Hotel Jakarta City Centre is a 5-star property with 256 rooms and suites, located within 400m of Istiqlal Mosque and Jakarta Cathedral and 800m from the Monas monument and Merdeka Palace. It has award-winning Indonesian, European, and Chinese restaurants plus a steakhouse and dessert cafe, Le Jardin Wellness spa, two ballrooms, and 10 meeting rooms. The hotel holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 1,792 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: Jalan Pecenongan No 7-17, Kebon Kelapa, 10120 Jakarta, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
